commands.name: inspect_terrain
commands.description: List editable terrain pieces with their IDs, dimensions and paint materials. Set target to inspect one terrain. Optional points sample the surface elevation at world X/Z coordinates.

commands.name: terrain_brush
commands.description: Apply one undoable brush stroke. Inspect terrain first for the target ID. Choose raise, lower, smooth, flatten or paint. Points are world [x,y,z] coordinates forming a path on the surface. Radius is in metres. Strength is metres per dab for raise/lower, and 0 to 1 for smoothing, flattening or paint. Flatten samples its first point. Paint takes a built-in or imported material ID from inspect_terrain.
